biggest_catch: Cashback is a rebate on purchases you were already going to make — it is not income and not guaranteed earnings. Rewards expire if you go 6 straight months with neither earning nor redeeming cashback, so small balances can vanish.
catches: Cashback is a rebate on spending, not income or guaranteed earnings — offers and rates change by location and retailer.
Rewards expire after six consecutive months with neither earning nor redeeming cashback.
Only qualifying purchases on activated offers count — buying outside the offer window or at a non-participating location earns nothing.
Violations of the offer terms can cause cashback forfeiture.

payout_quote: Claim a nearby offer, make the qualifying purchase, and earn cashback — cash out any time with no minimum to a bank account or gift cards; rewards expire after six consecutive months with neither earning nor redeeming.

s2.note: Free. Only activated-offer purchases qualify; expired or out-of-area offers earn nothing; violations can forfeit rewards.

s6.note: 6 concrete actions: claim offer, purchase in window, confirm credit, cash out.

steps: Install the free Upside app and create your account.
Search for offers near you and claim the ones you want before you buy.
Complete the qualifying purchase within the offer's window — for Pay with Upside, pay inside the app.
Check the app to confirm the cashback credited to your balance.
Earn or redeem at least once every six months so your rewards never expire.
When you are ready, cash out your full balance — there is no minimum.
Choose bank transfer or a gift card and follow the in-app confirmation.
timing: Pay with Upside can credit cashback within minutes; ordinary offers take longer depending on merchant confirmation. No minimum to cash out.

weasel_words.quote: Per-offer cashback rates are stated as 'up to' amounts that vary by merchant, location, and offer window.
